verdict.rationale: Mixpanel is a SaaS analytics product with public APIs, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair axis. The evidence documents APIs (Raw Event Export, Engage, Query, Feature Flags, JQL) and an MCP server. However, nothing in the pack mentions API version identifiers, versioned endpoints, or a documented deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
